Revoked device credential refusal

Registration and context snapshot
Heartbeat transitions at 35/65 seconds and reconnect on missing acknowledgement
Gateway restart plus session resume and bidirectional retransmission
Terminal journal replay with exactly one add-in execution
Indeterminate mutating invocation returns journal_indeterminate with zero re-executions
Indeterminate read invocation executes at most once more
Canonical-key params-digest mismatch fails as protocol
Authoritative window=1 rejection on one rsid, with parallel success across two rsid values
Proof that normal invokes do not send mcp_status preflight traffic
Failure enrichment using mcp_status after a simulated busy/timeout path
Ordered chunking, digest verification, progress, and backpressure
Params/result oversize rejection at the correct boundary
Cancellation with late real outcome preserved in the journal
Error mapping for method-not-found, invalid params, add-in exception, guarded result, and failure-shaped result
Exact 4-byte big-endian add-in framing vectors, including split/coalesced reads and the former 8192-byte case
atomic:false batch fan-out and failure index
atomic:true rejection without batch_atomic
atomic:true one-frame execute_batch success/rollback with batch_atomic
get_document_context propagation within 15 seconds without ExternalEvent polling
Duplicate/reordered data-frame handling across reconnect
Cross-device/cross-rsid resume and invocation authorization negatives
Gateway N/N-1 compatibility plus within-version additive-change vectors
Reconnect full-jitter bounds, 60-second cap, and reset only after 120 seconds continuously steady

Pending-expiry mutation installs the (rsid,mutation_scope) conflict hold; fresh-id invoke and batch writes are blocked; correlated read and late-terminal evidence exercise every retained/cleared transition and an invalid or inconclusive clearance never opens dispatch
Mixed terminal/non-terminal atomic:false batch redelivery plus atomic terminal replay/indeterminate recovery; every nested error carries explicit outcome/verification fields and affected scope holds

RFC 8785 params_digest, explicit per-step digest, and batch_digest golden vectors cover property order, number formatting, Unicode, escapes, step omission, params/digest mismatch, and changed policy/scope/clearance
heartbeat_ack, registration/unregistration/resume, cancel, goodbye, and manifest payload-schema positive/negative vectors
Chunk Base64 alphabet/padding, per-stream identity/indexing, decoded-byte limits, reconstruction size, and decoded-content digest
Loopback-only discovery/connect rejection for wildcard, LAN, hostname-resolved remote, and override targets
Session document-schema and seat/user spoof rejection against authenticated enrollment
Maximum-safe seq acceptance, unsafe 2^53 rejection, no-wrap renewal, duplicate, and gap behavior
WSS-primary and the exact Streamable HTTP/SSE create/events/messages lifecycle produce identical journal/resume outcomes, including opening-error and proxy-buffering vectors
Every session_unregister reason revokes resume, prevents new dispatch, and preserves a possibly dispatched mutation as indeterminate
status:"guarded" requires a valid guarded_reason; first-delivery atomic:false stops on that guarded step and marks all successors not_started
payload_omitted positive/negative vectors enforce replay-only use, required digest, absent result, and audited read-based recovery

GAP-7 RBP artifact vectors reject raw/local/traversal/reparse paths and prove multi-file artifact_id/artifact_index mapping, independent chunk streams, descriptor/digest/size verification, retransmission identity, and all-or-nothing invalid-member rejection; no north-client claim is made

O1-C01.statement: The peers negotiate the compatible RBP version.
The peers negotiate the exact granted capability intersection.

O1-C02.statement: A version mismatch is rejected with the compatible manifest pointer.
Version-mismatch reconnect attempts remain within the specified bound.

O1-C03.statement: A revoked device credential is refused before session authorization.

O1-C04.statement: A bounded scan discovers every fixture session in scope.
Discovery performs zero reads of a temporary registry file.

O1-C05.statement: The authenticated session registration is accepted with its exact schema.
The registered session carries the exact context snapshot.

O1-C06.statement: The heartbeat state makes the required transition at 35 seconds.
The heartbeat state makes the required transition at 65 seconds.
A missing heartbeat acknowledgement causes reconnect.

O1-C07.statement: The fixture survives a Gateway process restart.
The session resumes with its durable sequence state.
Unacknowledged bridge-to-Gateway data is retransmitted in sequence order.
Unacknowledged Gateway-to-bridge data is retransmitted in sequence order.

O1-C08.statement: A terminal journal row replays the stored terminal outcome.
Terminal replay leaves the add-in execution count exactly one.

O1-C09.statement: An indeterminate mutation returns journal_indeterminate with verification required.
The indeterminate mutation is never re-executed.

O1-C10.statement: An indeterminate read executes no more than one additional time.

O1-C11.statement: A canonical-key params digest mismatch terminates as a protocol fault.

O1-C12.statement: A second in-flight invocation on the same rsid is rejected at window one.
Invocations on two different rsid values can succeed in parallel.

O1-C13.statement: A normal invocation sends zero mcp_status preflight requests.

O1-C14.statement: The fixture produces the selected busy or timeout failure path.
Failure handling consults mcp_status only after the simulated failure.
The returned failure is enriched with the correlated mcp_status evidence.

O1-C15.statement: Chunks reconstruct in their required per-stream order.
The reconstructed decoded bytes match the terminal digest.
Progress remains correlated and deliverable during chunking.
Backpressure bounds data while control traffic remains serviceable.

O1-C16.statement: Oversize params are rejected at the specified params boundary.
Oversize results are rejected at the specified result boundary.

O1-C17.statement: Cancellation reaches the correlated in-flight invocation.
A later real outcome is retained as journal evidence after cancellation.

O1-C18.statement: Method-not-found maps to the specified RBP error.
Invalid params map to the specified RBP error.
An add-in exception maps to the specified RBP error.
A guarded add-in result maps to status guarded rather than failure.
A failure-shaped add-in result maps to the specified terminal failure.

O1-C19.statement: The add-in frame uses the exact four-byte big-endian length prefix.
A frame split across reads reconstructs exactly once.
Coalesced frames are separated and delivered in order.
The former 8192-byte boundary vector frames and reads correctly.

O1-C20.statement: An atomic false batch fans out steps in input order.
The result carries the zero-based first failed step index.

O1-C21.statement: An atomic true batch without batch_atomic terminates as unsupported.
No batch step executes when batch_atomic is absent.

O1-C22.statement: The atomic path is available only with the per-session batch_atomic grant.
A successful atomic batch executes as one frame and commits.
A failed atomic batch rolls back without any committed mutation claim.

O1-C23.statement: Document context propagates within fifteen seconds.
Context propagation performs zero ExternalEvent polling calls.

O1-C24.statement: A duplicate data frame is handled without duplicate execution or journal mutation.
Reordered data frames across reconnect are restored to authoritative sequence order.

O1-C25.statement: A resume token cannot be used by another device.
A resume token cannot be used for another rsid.
An invocation for a session not registered by the bridge is rejected.

O1-C26.statement: The Gateway accepts the current supported protocol version N.
The Gateway accepts the immediately prior supported protocol version N-1.
An additive within-version field change remains compatible.
A non-additive within-version change is rejected.

O1-C27.statement: Every reconnect delay stays within the full-jitter bound for its zero-based attempt index.
The reconnect base is capped at sixty seconds.
Backoff does not reset before 120 seconds of continuous steady connection.
Backoff resets after 120 seconds of continuous steady connection.

O1-C28.statement: Pending expiry installs the exact rsid and mutation_scope conflict hold.
A fresh invocation id cannot bypass the active mutation hold.
A conflicting batch write cannot bypass the active mutation hold.
An inconclusive correlated verification read retains the hold.
A valid conclusive correlated verification clearance clears the matching hold.
Correlated late-terminal evidence exercises the specified retained or cleared transition.
An invalid clearance never opens conflicting mutation dispatch.

O1-C29.statement: Non-atomic redelivery returns the exact mixed terminal and non-terminal step outcomes.
A durable atomic terminal result replays without add-in execution.
A possibly dispatched atomic batch recovers as wholly indeterminate without step retry.
Every nested error carries its complete outcome fields.
Every nested error carries its complete verification fields.
Every possibly executed mutating scope receives the required hold.

O1-C30.statement: RFC 8785 property-order variants produce the same params digest.
RFC 8785 number-formatting vectors produce the specified digest.
Unicode vectors use UTF-8 without extra normalization and produce the specified digest.
Equivalent JSON escape forms produce the same canonical digest.
A batch with an omitted step is rejected.
A params value and params_digest mismatch is rejected before dispatch.
Every explicit batch-step digest is independently verified.
The complete ordered batch digest is verified.
Redelivery with changed policy binding is rejected.
Redelivery with changed mutation scope is rejected.
Redelivery with changed recovery clearance is rejected.
Harmless property-order or escape reserialization is not treated as a digest mismatch.

O1-C31.statement: A valid heartbeat_ack payload is accepted.
An invalid heartbeat_ack payload is rejected.
A valid session_register payload is accepted.
An invalid session_register payload is rejected.
A valid session_unregister payload is accepted.
An invalid session_unregister payload is rejected.
A valid session_resume and resume_ack payload pair is accepted.
An invalid session_resume or resume_ack payload is rejected.
A valid cancel payload is accepted.
An invalid cancel payload is rejected.
A valid goodbye payload and reason is accepted.
An invalid goodbye payload or reason is rejected.

O1-C32.statement: Chunk data accepts only the specified Base64 alphabet.
Chunk data enforces valid Base64 padding.
Every chunk remains bound to its invocation and stream identity.
Chunk indexes are zero-based and contiguous independently per stream.
The per-chunk limit is enforced on decoded bytes.
The reconstructed byte count matches the terminal total size.
The ordered decoded content matches the terminal digest.

O1-C33.statement: An exact loopback target is accepted.
A wildcard listener or target is rejected.
A hostname resolving to a non-loopback address is rejected.
A configured non-loopback override target is rejected.

O1-C34.statement: Session document rows satisfy the exact document schema.
A bridge-claimed seat identity mismatch is rejected and audited.
A bridge-claimed user identity mismatch is rejected and audited.

O1-C35.statement: The maximum safe integer sequence value is accepted.
An unsafe 2^53 sequence value is rejected.
Approaching sequence exhaustion renews the session instead of wrapping.
A duplicate sequence is handled idempotently.
A sequence gap is detected and recovered without out-of-order acceptance.

O1-C36.statement: The WSS primary binding completes the required connection and message lifecycle.
The Streamable HTTP/SSE binding completes create, events, and messages lifecycle.
Both bindings produce identical journal outcomes.
Both bindings produce identical resume outcomes.
Both bindings enforce the exact opening-error matrix.
The Streamable HTTP/SSE path survives the specified proxy-buffering vector.

O1-C37.statement: revit_exited revokes the session resume token.
revit_exited preserves a possibly dispatched mutation as indeterminate.
bridge_shutdown revokes the session resume token.
bridge_shutdown preserves a possibly dispatched mutation as indeterminate.
session_replaced revokes the session resume token.
session_replaced preserves a possibly dispatched mutation as indeterminate.
operator_requested revokes the session resume token.
operator_requested preserves a possibly dispatched mutation as indeterminate.

O1-C38.statement: status guarded is accepted only with a valid guarded_reason.
A guarded result without guarded_reason is rejected.
A first-delivery atomic false batch stops on the guarded step.
Every successor after the guarded step is marked not_started and does not execute.

O1-C39.statement: payload_omitted true is accepted only on replay.
payload_omitted true on a non-replay result is rejected.
payload_omitted true requires the retained result digest.
payload_omitted true forbids an inline result payload.
Omitted payload recovery uses an audited correlated read rather than a guessed mutation result.

O1-C40.statement: An undeclared raw artifact path is rejected.
A workstation-local path is never exposed in the sanitized result.
A symlink, junction, or reparse artifact path is rejected.
Every sanitized output member maps to one stable unique artifact_id.
artifact_index values are deterministic, zero-based, contiguous, and input ordered.
Every file uses an independent artifact chunk stream with independent indexing.
Every terminal artifact descriptor matches its mapped stream identity and metadata.
Every reconstructed artifact stream matches its descriptor digest.
Every reconstructed artifact stream matches its descriptor size and combined limits.
Retransmission and replay preserve artifact ids, indexes, descriptors, stream ids, and bytes exactly.
One invalid member rejects the entire multi-file conversion before any sibling chunk is emitted.
RBP artifact evidence makes no client upload, resource, display, download, or north-client conformance claim.
